A further current-version recovery replay delivered a reset message and reached the canonical reset page; it did not submit the final password change. A Google account-selection attempt returned through the state/CSRF guard in an agent-controlled Chrome surface, so it is retained as inconclusive rather than attributed to provider configuration or ordinary-user behavior. A Version 21 to Version 18 private rollback followed by a Version 18 to Version 21 private restore succeeded with environment revision 8 and the owner-only access invariant unchanged. The local unauthenticated control audit separately found 0 no-visible-effect controls of 140. This does not prove application-data continuity through the temporary rollback, a physical second device, direct D1/R2 reconciliation, current Google callback, final reset sign-in, public audience or final product acceptance.
